question.text: Per the workbook's effective-rate table for LTCG on listed STT-paid equity shares held by a Cat III AIF trust in the hands of individuals/HUF/AOP/BOI (post-surcharge-cap and cess), the effective rate is:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's effective-rate table shows 14.95% for individuals/HUF/AOP/BOI on LTCG (both Section 112A listed equity and 'other LTCG'). This is 12.5% base + 15% max surcharge cap (Section 112A/111A) + 4% cess = approx 14.95%. 14.56% is the rate for 'Other' and corporate residents (no individual surcharge top-up). 13.65% is the foreign-corporate effective LTCG rate. 12.5% is the statutory rate pre-surcharge/cess. The Trap: A (14.56%) uses the corporate/other-investor effective rate. C is the foreign corporate rate. D is the pre-surcharge statutory rate. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-D (Cat I/II) uses the same rate table because pass-through LPs are taxed at the same character-wise rates. XIX-E makes the rate the FUND's problem because the fund is representative assessee. Manager's Pro-Tip: For Kaveri or Nilgiri, quote the 14.95% effective rate (not the headline 12.5%) to LPs in fact sheets. Missing the surcharge + cess stack understates NAV drag and invites LP complaints after realisation.
